grammar.topic: there is / there are + a / an / some / any + prepositions of place
explainTr: Bir şeyin yerde var olduğunu söylerken 'there is' (tekil) ve 'there are' (çoğul) kullanırız. Tekil sayılabilir isimde a / an gelir: There is a bank. Çoğulda 'some' gelir: There are some chairs.

Olumsuz ve soruda 'some' yerine 'any' kullanılır: There aren't any stores. Are there any parks? Yer bildiren kelimeler: in (içinde), on (üstünde), under (altında), next to (yanında), between (arasında), across from (karşısında).
grammar.compareTr: Türkçede 'Evde bir masa var' dersin; 'var' sona gelir. İngilizcede 'var' kısmı başa gelir: 'There is a table in the house.' Olumsuzda 'yok' için de aynı yapı kullanılır: 'There isn't a table.'

reading.title: Hafsa's apartment and street
reading.text:
Hafsa's apartment is on the second floor. There is a small kitchen and there are two bedrooms. There is one bathroom. There are two big windows in the living room. The apartment is clean and bright.

Her street is quiet. There is a grocery store across from her building. There is a pharmacy next to the grocery store. There is a park between the pharmacy and the bank. There aren't any restaurants on the street, but there is a bakery on the corner.

Hafsa likes her new neighborhood. Everything is near, and her neighbors are nice. On Sunday, she and Emre walk to the park.

questions.whyTr: 'There is a grocery store across from her building.'

questions.q: What is between the pharmacy and the bank?
questions.whyTr: 'There is a park between the pharmacy and the bank.'

questions.q: How many bedrooms are there in Hafsa's apartment?

questions.whyTr: 'There is a bakery on the corner.'

listening.title: Hafsa asks Linda about the neighborhood

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Linda, is there a good grocery store near here?

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Yes, there is. Fresh Market is on Oak Street. It is across from the bank.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: No, it isn't. It is five minutes from your apartment.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Great. Are there any pharmacies near here?

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: Yes, there is a pharmacy next to the grocery store.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: And is there a park? Emre likes to play outside.

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: There is a nice park next to the school. It is very clean.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Perfect. Are there any buses on Sunday?

script.speaker: Linda
script.text: No, there aren't any buses on Sunday. You can walk, though.

script.speaker: Hafsa
script.text: Thank you for your help, Linda.
